name: Kunshan Kinglai Hygienic Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kunshan Kinglai Hygienic Materials Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of clean and high-purity stainless steel application materials in China. It offers chambers, valves, pumps, flanges, pressure vessels, tubes, fittings, and other products. The company's products are used in electronic specialty gas, solar, bio-technology, pharmaceuticals, fine chemical, food and beverage, dairy, cosmetics, and vaccine sectors. Kunshan Kinglai Hygienic Materials Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Kunshan, China.
